specDepthDecision.rationale: Compound articulated assembly with radial repetition and mixed transparency.

detailInventory.note: Each observed or inferred identity detail maps to a named component feature.

details.description: Long cream motor head with domed nose and rounded rear cap.
Continuous Sakura-pink horizontal band around the lower head.
Layered circular pink speed dial on the front face.
Small stepped release lever below the left side of the head.
Tapered pink rear column with a deep bowl clearance arch.
Large concentric pink side hinge disc connecting head and column.
Cream stepped drive collar beneath the head.
Six bowed metal whisk wires converge at a lower ring.
Deep cream bowl with flared rolled rim and rounded base.
Thick cream U-shaped handle attached to the bowl side.
Wide pink plinth with softened corners and lower step.
Concentric cream-and-pink lower column control dial.
Eight narrow vertical ventilation slots in an arched rear recess.
Four shallow rubber feet under the plinth.
Rear lower power cable connection socket.

definitionOfDone: The stand mixer matches the turn-sheet silhouette, head-to-column-to-bowl proportions, repeated whisk and rear vent structures, pastel material separation, and clearly communicates mixing during the 5.2 second powered cue.
